source_description: Tenrec official SBR derived dataset: click-positive histories, items with corpus frequency below 2 or above 200000 removed, first 1M grouped user histories
selection: first 10000 user groups from the official SBR file
split: per-user next-item: all but last two events train; penultimate validation target; final event test target; users retained only when both targets occur in the selected cohort's training catalog
negative_sampling: training only; negatives excluded from the user's training history; validation/test use full train-seen catalog via FAISS
candidate_catalog: items present in the training histories of the selected cohort
